action: Update Ghostscript to 10.08.0, which pwn.ai says fixes the flaw; on distributions that have not shipped it, apply the distribution's Ghostscript security update when available.
date_note: The Hacker News article of 22 November is the first page found describing the application demonstrations; the fix (10.08.0) dates from 8 September and the CVE record from 9 November.
exec: A Ghostscript flaw can let a crafted document uploaded to or processed by common applications escape Ghostscript's sandbox; it is fixed in 10.08.0, and The Hacker News reports no attacks.
plain: Security firm pwn.ai showed that a specially made file sent to about ten common applications that use Ghostscript could break out of its safety restrictions. A fix, version 10.08.0, exists; no attacks are reported.

key_findings: pwn.ai demonstrated a Ghostscript sandbox escape through upload, preview and print features in about ten common applications.
The flaw, CVE-2026-125396, was fixed in Ghostscript 10.08.0 on September 8; The Hacker News reports no attacks.
VulnCheck's advisory lists it as affecting ghostpdl >= 0, < 10.08.0 with CVSS 8.5.

sources.name: The Hacker News: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
VulnCheck advisory: Ghostscript before 10.08.0, dSAFER bypass

summary: pwn.ai demonstrated that a crafted file can escape Ghostscript's sandbox through upload, preview and print features in about ten common applications. The flaw, CVE-2026-125396, is scored 8.5 in VulnCheck's advisory, which lists ghostpdl >= 0, < 10.08.0 as affected. pwn.ai says Ghostscript 10.08.0 fixes it, and The Hacker News reports no attacks.
title: pwn.ai shows Ghostscript sandbox escape (CVE-2026-125396) through file uploads in about ten applications

validation.note: The Hacker News, VulnCheck's advisory and the researchers' own pwn.ai page each state the CVE and the 10.08.0 fix; the pwn.ai page is the researchers' primary write-up. The Ghostscript bug tracker page (709684) blocked automated readers and was not read.
